analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-buffer-overflow due to an out-of-bounds 2-byte read when parsing non-certificate TLS handshake records. In getSSCertificateFingerprint(), the code checks `packet->payload_packet_len > flow->l4.tcp.tls_record_offset+7` but then reads `*(u_int16_t*)&packet->payload[flow->l4.tcp.tls_record_offset+7]`, which requires bytes at offsets +7 and +8. The bounds check is off by one and allows reading past the end when only 8 bytes remain.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: From fuzz_process_packet, attacker-controlled packet payload reaches ndpi_search_tls_tcp_udp() -> tlsDetectProtocolFromCertificate() -> getSSCertificateFingerprint(). The flow must take the branch handling handshake/non-certificate records (`else if(packet->payload_packet_len > flow->l4.tcp.tls_record_offset+7)`), with payload length such that `payload_packet_len == tls_record_offset + 8` (or otherwise lacking byte +8). Then `ntohs(*(u_int16_t*)&payload[offset+7])` performs a 2-byte read beyond the heap buffer, triggering ASan.
